title: The platforms moved before AIR launched
subtitle: The memo's largest stated risk was that platform verification could not be diligenced. Two of three platforms had shipped it by May.

events.label: Anthropic: ongoing directory review
events.detail: Software Directory Policy updated April 15, 2026: initial and ongoing reviews, and developers must verify ownership of external resources their software retrieves.

events.label: Microsoft Agent 365 GA
events.detail: $15 per user per month on top of an E5-class licence; converging into a unified agent registry with publisher provenance.

caption: Platform review covers a platform's own directory, not the add-on an enterprise installs from anywhere else, and neither platform has shipped cryptographic signing. That gap is the whole of AIR's position, and it is narrower than the memo first described.
source: support.claude.com, Anthropic Software Directory Policy; Microsoft Learn, Agent Registry convergence; TechCrunch, September 1, 2026.
